# Steady 2.21.13

## What's new
- **Launch crash fix** — Sentry’s auto ContentProvider required a DSN and killed the app on open when `keys/sentry.json` was absent. Auto-init is disabled; optional Sentry still works when a DSN is configured. GitHub crash sync unchanged.
- **VPN establish on main service thread again** — background `establish()` was unsafe on many OEM Androids; filter security behavior is unchanged.

## For parents
Install this build if Steady opened and closed immediately after 2.21.12. Protection / Accessibility / Device Owner rules are the same as before.
